title: Word Count
description:
Store `s = "  hello world  "`. Strip the whitespace from both ends, split it into words, and print the number of words.

**Expected output:**
```
2
```
starterCode:
s = "  hello world  "
# Strip whitespace, split into words, print word count
hint: Chain the operations: s.strip() removes whitespace, then .split() splits into a list. Use len() on the result.
